a: Of God, and of the Holy Trinity
The Deity of the Holy Spirit
x: It pleased God the Father, Son, and Holy Ghost
In the beginning it pleased God the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit
who is infinite in being and perfection
But Christ and the Holy Spirit made all things and are worshiped just as the Father is.
…“God brought them out,” “God was tested,” “God performed miracles”—are attributed to the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit. See
